# hussh Private Agent One

> Consent-first personal agent platform (`hussh.si`), combining a Zero-Knowledge Central Encrypted PKM Mirror (`<50ms` cross-device sync, Scope Paid Sharing, and MCP at `$0` wake cost), single-container sovereign `One` compute across `hussh` Confidential Sandboxes, Owner Cloud BYOC (Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure), and Local Puppy, and out-of-sandbox Sentinel company-key mediation.

## Coding-Agent Entrypoints

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Root portable operating contract for every coding agent
- [.agents/instructions.md](.agents/instructions.md): Binding repository engineering contract and resource lifecycle gates
- [.agents/README.md](.agents/README.md): Skills, workflows, subagents, routing, and evaluation framework
- [docs/development/documentation.md](docs/development/documentation.md): Dual-audience documentation standard (Hybrid Tiered, living Mermaid diagrams, Zero-Archive policy)
